```{r setup}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/Alyssa/Single_Cell_CHIP_Vascular/")
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(slingshot)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
```

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly=TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("kstreet13/slingshot")
```


```{r}
mpp_data = readRDS("../Scale/rds_objects/11562-JVA/2_myeloid_merged_obj.rds")
mpp_data = subset(mpp_data, subset = CRISPR_target %in% c("AAVS", "TET2") & stim_status == "unstim")
```

# slingshot vignette: https://bioconductor.org/packages/devel/bioc/vignettes/slingshot/inst/doc/vignette.html
```{r}
mpp_sce = as.SingleCellExperiment(mpp_data)
```


# filter genes down to potential cell-type markers
# at least M (15) reads in at least N (15) cells
```{r}
geneFilter <- apply(assays(mpp_sce)$counts,1,function(x){
    sum(x >= 3) >= 10
})
mpp_sce <- mpp_sce[geneFilter, ]
```


# normalize
```{r}
FQnorm <- function(counts){
    rk <- apply(counts,2,rank,ties.method='min')
    counts.sort <- apply(counts,2,sort)
    refdist <- apply(counts.sort,1,median)
    norm <- apply(rk,2,function(r){ refdist[r] })
    rownames(norm) <- rownames(counts)
    return(norm)
}
assays(mpp_sce)$norm <- FQnorm(assays(mpp_sce)$counts)
```


# dimensionality reduction with pca
```{r}
pca <- prcomp(t(log1p(assays(mpp_sce)$norm)), scale. = FALSE)
rd1 <- pca$x[,1:2]

plot(rd1, col = rgb(0,0,0,.5), pch=16, asp = 1)
```


# with umap
```{r}
library(uwot)

rd2 <- uwot::umap(t(log1p(assays(mpp_sce)$norm)))
colnames(rd2) <- c('UMAP1', 'UMAP2')

plot(rd2, col = rgb(0,0,0,.5), pch=16, asp = 1)
```


# add pca and umap to object
```{r}
reducedDims(mpp_sce) <- SimpleList(PCA = rd1, UMAP = rd2)
```


# get pseudotime clusters
```{r}
library(mclust, quietly = TRUE)
cl1 <- Mclust(rd1)$classification
colData(mpp_sce)$GMM <- cl1

library(RColorBrewer)
plot(rd1, col = brewer.pal(9,"Set1")[cl1], pch=16, asp = 1)

cl2 <- kmeans(rd1, centers = 4)$cluster
colData(mpp_sce)$kmeans <- cl2

plot(rd1, col = brewer.pal(9,"Set1")[cl2], pch=16, asp = 1)
```


# run slingshot
```{r}
mpp_sce <- slingshot(mpp_sce, clusterLabels = 'GMM', reducedDim = 'PCA')

saveRDS(mpp_sce, "rds_objects/slingshot/mpp_sce.rds")
```

```{r}
library(grDevices)
colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11,'Spectral')[-6])(100)
plotcol <- colors[cut(mpp_sce$slingPseudotime_1, breaks=100)]

plot(reducedDims(mpp_sce)$PCA, col = plotcol, pch=16, asp = 1)
lines(SlingshotDataSet(mpp_sce), lwd=2, col='black')
```


# plot with clusters
```{r}
plot(reducedDims(mpp_sce)$PCA, col = brewer.pal(9,'Set1')[mpp_sce$GMM], pch=16, asp = 1)
lines(SlingshotDataSet(mpp_sce), lwd=2, type = 'lineages', col = 'black')

```



# identify temporally dynamic genes
```{r}
library(tradeSeq)

# fit negative binomial GAM
downsampled_sce <- fitGAM(downsampled_sce)

# test for dynamic expression
ATres <- associationTest(downsampled_sce)
```



# plot on heatmap
```{r}
topgenes <- rownames(ATres[order(ATres$pvalue), ])[1:250]
pst.ord <- order(sce$slingPseudotime_1, na.last = NA)
heatdata <- assays(mpp_sce)$counts[topgenes, pst.ord]
heatclus <- mpp_sce$GMM[pst.ord]

heatmap(log1p(heatdata), Colv = NA,
        ColSideColors = brewer.pal(9,"Set1")[heatclus])
```




# downsample sce
```{r}
downsampled_sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(mpp_data)

# Set the fraction of cells to keep (e.g., 0.5 for 50%)
fraction_to_keep <- 0.1

# Get the total number of cells
total_cells <- ncol(downsampled_sce)

# Randomly sample cell indices
sampled_cells <- sample(seq_len(total_cells), size = round(fraction_to_keep * total_cells))

# Subset the SingleCellExperiment object
downsampled_sce <- downsampled_sce[, sampled_cells]
```


# filter genes down to potential cell-type markers
# at least M (15) reads in at least N (15) cells
```{r}
geneFilter <- apply(assays(downsampled_sce)$counts,1,function(x){
    sum(x >= 3) >= 10
})
downsampled_sce <- downsampled_sce[geneFilter, ]
```


# normalize
```{r}
FQnorm <- function(counts){
    rk <- apply(counts,2,rank,ties.method='min')
    counts.sort <- apply(counts,2,sort)
    refdist <- apply(counts.sort,1,median)
    norm <- apply(rk,2,function(r){ refdist[r] })
    rownames(norm) <- rownames(counts)
    return(norm)
}
assays(downsampled_sce)$norm <- FQnorm(assays(downsampled_sce)$counts)
```


# dimensionality reduction with pca
```{r}
pca <- prcomp(t(log1p(assays(downsampled_sce)$norm)), scale. = FALSE)
rd1 <- pca$x[,1:2]

plot(rd1, col = rgb(0,0,0,.5), pch=16, asp = 1)
```


# add pca and umap to object
```{r}
reducedDims(downsampled_sce) <- SimpleList(PCA = rd1)
```


# get pseudotime clusters
```{r}
library(mclust, quietly = TRUE)
cl1 <- Mclust(rd1)$classification
colData(downsampled_sce)$GMM <- cl1

library(RColorBrewer)
plot(rd1, col = brewer.pal(9,"Set1")[cl1], pch=16, asp = 1)

cl2 <- kmeans(rd1, centers = 4)$cluster
colData(downsampled_sce)$kmeans <- cl2

plot(rd1, col = brewer.pal(9,"Set1")[cl2], pch=16, asp = 1)
```


# run slingshot
```{r}
downsampled_sce <- slingshot(downsampled_sce, clusterLabels = 'GMM', reducedDim = 'PCA')

saveRDS(downsampled_sce, "rds_objects/slingshot/downsampled_sce.rds")
```

```{r}
library(grDevices)
colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11,'Spectral')[-6])(100)
plotcol <- colors[cut(downsampled_sce$slingPseudotime_1, breaks=100)]

plot(reducedDims(downsampled_sce)$PCA, col = plotcol, pch=16, asp = 1)
lines(SlingshotDataSet(downsampled_sce), lwd=2, col='black')
```


# plot with clusters
```{r}
plot(reducedDims(downsampled_sce)$PCA, col = brewer.pal(9,'Set1')[downsampled_sce$GMM], pch=16, asp = 1)
lines(SlingshotDataSet(downsampled_sce), lwd=2, type = 'lineages', col = 'black')
```
```{r}
library(tradeSeq)

# fit negative binomial GAM
downsampled_sce <- fitGAM(downsampled_sce)

# test for dynamic expression
ATres <- associationTest(downsampled_sce)
```

```{r}
topgenes <- rownames(ATres[order(ATres$pvalue), ])[1:250]
pst.ord <- order(downsampled_sce$slingPseudotime_1, na.last = NA)
heatdata <- assays(downsampled_sce)$counts[topgenes, pst.ord]
heatclus <- downsampled_sce$GMM[pst.ord]

heatmap(as.matrix(log1p(heatdata)), Colv = NA,
        ColSideColors = brewer.pal(9,"Set1")[heatclus])
```
